cancelled_label_handling: Visible label text is rlapped once; an invisible deleted copy supplies state/dimensions. Actual cancellation strokes are independently owned. Sigma groups in cancelled passages also have one invisible deleted-state annotation.
word_boundary_audit: G04 owns both small parentheses, alpha-in-K and the outer final closer; etant/disjoints are T11 and are not duplicated.
G05 owns no formula words or symbols; G06 owns intersection/limit and S03 owns its complete Sigma.
G10 owns both inserted expressions and their state qualifier; individual children retain exact paths and indices.
G14 owns only long cancellation geometry; all prose words and glyph bodies lie in named label/Sigma groups.
M01–M06 own only their selected traces. The adjoining words/indices remain outside their groups.
Final et on doit prouver, closure display and ce qui est immédiat appear once outside the figure.
validation_scope: structural source checks only; no compilation or rendering was invoked

component_count_convention: Each listed draw command contains one continuous path; each fill command contains one point-shaped fill. Paths can share endpoints or cross within a complete group. Command counts are kept separate from physical glyph/cluster counts and from font-rendered label strokes.
resolved_concrete_source_defects: Exact C source-line bounds corrected at the small annotations, Comme passage, inverse display, Soit line and precise clause.
S12 head/body source path now shares the declared upper vertex, matching its connected-arm source classification.
Actual H quoted scopes preserve their original line wraps and apostrophe, with local marker flags confined to the two ill placeholders.
